clue.text: Guilelessness and love seen in a dog

indicators.note: seen in places the words before it inside the dog word that follows

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
taken as written
love is nil in tennis scoring, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A dog shows innocence and affection.
explanation.definitionFit: Candour is frankness and openness, a lack of guile or deceit.

clue.text: Caused trouble, getting Bill and Edward out of bed

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
Ted is a familiar form of the name Edward
someone who has risen is up

explanation.surface: Bill and Edward made a fuss when dragged from their beds.
explanation.definitionFit: To act up is a phrasal verb for misbehaving or making trouble.

clue.text: Largely drank up a store of supplies

indicators.note: in a down entry, up says the word for drinking is read from the bottom

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily, so toped is drank in large measure

explanation.surface: Someone drank up most of the provisions in the storeroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns TOPED into the store. 'Largely' looks like a truncation signal but is part of the synonym: toping is heavy drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a warehouse or storehouse where goods and supplies are kept.

clue.text: Turn up in a foreign land

parts.note: un is French for a, so a foreign word for a
earth means land or ground

explanation.definitionFit: To unearth is to dig out or discover, so to bring something to light.

clue.text: Jewish father puts fresh bar on some pork

indicators.note: fresh suggests the word bar remade in a new form

parts.note: a ham is a cut of pork, so some pork

explanation.surface: A Jewish man oddly places a new bar on pork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fresh' rearranges BAR into ABR, which sits before A HAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Abraham is the patriarch, the founding father of the Jewish people.

clue.text: Perform in panto horse perhaps? That creates interest

definitions.meaning: a pantomime horse is two actors, each playing one part of it, so each must be one of its two portions
the sense found in 'on ... of', meaning in someone's interest or for their benefit

explanation.surface: Acting in a pantomime horse costume is meant to be entertaining.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading splits the word into BE HALF: an actor in a two-person horse costume plays one of its two portions.
explanation.definitionFit: Behalf means benefit or interest, as in acting on someone's behalf.

clue.text: Advocate appearing for a Venetian explorer gains essential point

parts.note: Marco Polo was the explorer from Venice
the gist is the main point or essence

explanation.surface: A lawyer acting for an Italian traveller gets to the heart of the matter.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologist is someone who argues in defence of a cause, so a champion of it.

clue.text: Having no object in bothering Melissa

indicators.note: bothering suggests upset, so the name Melissa is disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone with no reason to pester Melissa.
explanation.definitionFit: Aimless means without purpose or goal, lacking any object in view.

clue.text: Driving force

parts.note: read as a police force dealing with driving, not as a motivating power

explanation.definitionFit: Traffic officers are the branch of the police responsible for motorists and roads.

clue.text: Block and tackle

definitions.meaning: to block is to obstruct or prevent
to tackle a player is to halt their progress

explanation.definitionFit: Stop means to halt or obstruct, both as a block and as a tackle on a player.

clue.text: Creatures ruining the marrows

indicators.note: ruining suggests the words the marrows are wrecked and their letters reshaped

explanation.surface: Garden pests spoil the vegetable patch's marrows.
explanation.definitionFit: Earthworms are burrowing animals, living creatures of the soil.

clue.text: Newspaperman to be found in dire trouble

indicators.note: trouble suggests disorder, so the letters of to and dire are stirred up

explanation.surface: A journalist finds himself in serious difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: An editor is the journalist in charge of a newspaper's content.

clue.text: Too late for an American cropper to come a cropper?

definitions.text: Too late for an American cropper
definitions.meaning: Americans call autumn fall, harvest time for a cropper, a crop farmer; when fall is ended it is too late to reap
a British idiom meaning to take a heavy tumble

explanation.surface: Missing the harvest leaves a US farmer badly off.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is printed as one run, 'Too late for an American cropper to come a cropper?', with 'to' as the link between its two readings.
explanation.definitionFit: To topple is to lose one's footing, the plain sense of coming a cropper.

clue.text: Colour scheme that's out of date

definitions.text: Colour scheme that's out of date

parts.words: Colour scheme that's out of date
parts.note: reads like an old-fashioned decor but means a system of racial separation, now abolished

explanation.definitionFit: South Africa's former policy of racial segregation was a scheme based on skin colour, ended in the 1990s.

clue.text: Rush over to meet

parts.note: to rush is to run
across means over, from one side to the other

explanation.surface: Hurry across the road to greet someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To come upon someone unexpectedly is to encounter them by chance.

clue.text: Climbing gear?

parts.note: not mountaineering equipment but the lowest car gear, used for going up steep hills

explanation.definitionFit: The lowest gear in a car, used for climbing steep slopes, is the one numbered one.

clue.text: Checks over container ship outside

indicators.note: outside puts the ship letters around the container word

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: Inspectors examine the cargo box on the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan is to look over or examine something quickly.

clue.text: Partners who dance up in close formation

indicators.note: in puts the up letters inside the reworked word
formation suggests the letters of close arranged into a new shape

explanation.surface: Dancers come together in a tight group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'formation' rearranges CLOSE into COLES, and 'in' places UP inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dancers who take the floor two by two are pairs of partners.

clue.text: It's not material for a religious song

definitions.meaning: concerned with the soul rather than physical things
a type of hymn from the African-American tradition

explanation.definitionFit: Spiritual means of the soul rather than the body, and is also a gospel song.

clue.text: A quick reply by one who is foiled?

definitions.text: A quick reply by one who is foiled?

parts.words: A quick reply by one who is foiled?
parts.note: foiled suggests defeated, but here means fencing with a foil, where a return thrust follows a parry

explanation.definitionFit: A fencer's return thrust after parrying, and by extension any witty retort.

clue.text: Footballers' magazine

definitions.meaning: a store of weapons and ammunition

explanation.walkthrough: ARSENAL is a famous English football club from north London.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenal is a north London football club and also a weapons store.

clue.text: Capital power unit setting up in middle of road

indicators.note: in places the turned unit inside the central letters
middle of takes the central letters of road
in a down entry, setting up says the unit is read upwards

parts.note: the watt is the SI unit of power

explanation.surface: A capital's electricity unit is being installed in the middle of the street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting up' turns WATT into TTAW, and 'in' sits it between O and A, the middle of 'road'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.

clue.text: Drunk male cuts drink

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters of male and cuts reeling about

explanation.surface: An inebriated man is waters down his tipple.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscatel is a sweet wine made from muscat grapes.

clue.text: Intently study for every purpose

parts.note: per means for each
use means purpose or function

explanation.surface: Concentrate on reading for each intended aim.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read or examine thoroughly and carefully.

clue.text: Reach the same sound conclusion

parts.note: sounds like agreeing on a sensible verdict, but means two words ending with matching sounds

explanation.definitionFit: Words chime together in verse when their endings share the same sound.

clue.text: Adjustments for expenses?

definitions.meaning: concessions made for circumstances, as with a price
regular sums paid to cover costs

explanation.definitionFit: These are both concessions made for factors and payments to cover spending.

clue.text: American tug?

definitions.meaning: informal word for a person from the USA

explanation.definitionFit: Yank is slang for a US citizen and also means a sudden jerk or pull.

clue.text: It's customary for injured escort to leave assault course exercise

indicators.note: injured signals the letters of escort are broken up before removal
to leave says the escort letters are taken away from the longer phrase
exercise suggests the remaining letters are worked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A hurt bodyguard routinely drops out of military training.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the letters of ESCORT out of ASSAULT COURSE, in any order, and rearrange what remains: A, A, L, S, S, U, U.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done as usual is the normal, customary practice.

clue.text: Rings again and cancels

definitions.meaning: peals are rings of bells, and re- means again

explanation.definitionFit: Repeals means revokes or annuls a law, and split it reads as bells ringing once more.
